title: Maintenance settings sit under Settings and need Settings Service
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an Owner/Admin, or a user with "Settings Service" enabled, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on for the shop (it ships behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. In the left sidebar under Settings choose "Maintenance" (it sits beneath "Inspection Templates"). Schedules here belong to the location chosen in the header.
  3. A second test user WITHOUT "Settings Service" (set under Settings > Staff / Roles).
custom_steps:
1. As a user WITH Settings Service, open Settings and find the Maintenance entry; note where it sits and what it lists.
  2. Look for any separate reminder-settings tab.
  3. Sign in as the user WITHOUT Settings Service and try to reach the Maintenance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Settings shows a "Maintenance" entry beneath "Inspection Templates", holding a single list of maintenance schedules; each schedule belongs to the location it was built at.
  • There is no separate reminder-settings tab.
  • The user without "Settings Service" cannot reach the Maintenance tab.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10558 (S1, Create a maintenance schedule); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), Part 1 / S1; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R1: “Settings will carry a Maintenance entry with a single list of maintenance schedules. A schedule belongs to the location it was built at, as canned lines and inspection templates do ... There is no reminder settings tab, because the email carries no shop-editable content”
  • S1-N2: “A user without Settings Service cannot reach the tab”
